verification_model.accountable_front: Gobernanza — frente centralizador e integrador del sprint
verification_model.new_thread_resume_rule: For every new Governance conversation: verify main HEAD and the current Governance CONTROL; read the complete current DUG; read Governance task index, GOV-TASK-011 and this evidence; recover the latest actually processed cursor for each existing EP/MCP coordination object; read all new messages; respond at the beginning in the same object; process only authorized work; close/read-back in the same entry; then integrate. Never reset history, create parallel channels or use an old snapshot as current.

truth_criterion.operator_instruction: Define objetivos y decisiones dentro del DUG y las autorizaciones reales.

governance_own_progress.constraint: No suplanta a EP/MCP-OCP ni cruza controles, host, código o autorizaciones.

conversation_parallelism.coordination_scope: Integrate traceable results, dependencies, decisions and evidence without reallocating either session's mandate or functions.
conversation_parallelism.acceptance_rule: A result is integrated only after it is visible in the shared canonical object or supplied through a verifiable handoff.
conversation_parallelism.shared_write_rule: Serialize writes to the same mutable path; reread current blob, write with SHA guard, abort on mismatch, reconcile and perform exact read-back.
